name: Save Techbot's Brain!
summary: Tinkmaster Overspark sends Alliance adventurers into Gnomeregan for Techbot's memory core. The machine once aided researchers, but radiation and an electrical surge during the city's fall left its brain polarized and its behavior violent. Overspark hopes the core will help him reverse the damage and restore his creation.

sections.title: A Mind Inverted
sections.body: Before Gnomeregan fell, Techbot aided researchers with its many devices and vast technical knowledge. Tinkmaster Overspark designed the mechanical assistant, whose integrated gizmos made it a marvel of gnomish ingenuity. The trogg invasion brought chaos, and toxic radiation filled the city. A stray electrical surge jolted Techbot's delicate inner workings, polarizing its positronic brain into a volatile negatronic state.

sections.title: Salvage Operation
sections.body: Techbot now wanders Gnomeregan's contaminated halls in a frenzy, attacking anyone in sight. Overspark refuses to abandon his prized assistant as scrap. He asks capable operatives to find the machine, remove its memory core from the metal chassis, and bring it to Ironforge. With the core, the Tinkmaster hopes to understand the polarization and repair Techbot's mind.

faq.answer: Techbot is a mechanical assistant designed by Tinkmaster Overspark. Before Gnomeregan fell, it helped the Tinkmaster and his associates with its vast store of knowledge and built-in gizmos.
A stray electrical spark jolted Techbot's positronic brain during Gnomeregan's fall. The shock reversed its neural alignment into a negatronic state, turning its helpful nature into a violent frenzy.
Techbot wanders Gnomeregan's outer corridors and staging halls, beyond the perimeter where exiled gnomes and dwarven expeditionary forces operate.
Tinkmaster Overspark offers the request from Tinker Town in Ironforge. There, he oversees salvage and research for High Tinker Gelbin Mekkatorque.
Tinkmaster Overspark believes Techbot's memory core will help him find the cause of its negatronic polarization and restore the machine to working order.

faq.q: What happens after returning the memory core?
faq.answer: When Overspark receives the core, he begins preparing to dismantle and reconfigure the inverted circuits. Finding the right tools in his cluttered workshop is a challenge of its own.

angles.text: As a gnome, Techbot shows how the loss of your home city damaged even its finest intellectual creations.
As an engineer, you can see in Techbot's shift from positronic to negatronic how catastrophe can warp complex computational matrices.
As an Alliance member, recovering lost technology from Gnomeregan's contaminated perimeter helps support the gnomish refugees sheltering in Ironforge.
